name: A2E Suite — Tier 0/1 batch II: stability & usability (dependency-ready, Twenty-native reuse)
description: Executor batch extracted from PLAN.md (reconciled 2026-09-19 ledger). Scope rule: only `[ ]`/`[~]` bullets whose own dependency references are `[x]`/DONE, implementation + unit-test work only (Tier 0/1 per the executor contract; no running app, no browser/e2e/multi-session, no 621-spec sweep). Maximal reuse of existing Twenty primitives (views, settings surfaces, command menu, context-store, tool registry, native import/export, template service) — no parallel systems. Deferred — needs orchestrator (Tier 2, NOT in this batch): P1.1 uninstall live proof; P1.3 e2e preset journey; P1.7c E01–E04/E12; P2.1 Redis fan-out across instances + real-session integration tests (note: P2.1 bullets 1/3 overlap P0.3 DONE work — orchestrator to reconcile); P2.4 dock/tab browser E2E; P2.5 live provider validation + p95<150ms budget; P3.2 comment-reload/second-session leg + nonempty-export browser leg + share absolute-URL (needs SDK pin decision); P4.1 installed relations/permissions/layouts live validation; P4.2 Gantt DOM render + 1k-task benchmark, time-tracker DOM heartbeat, live app-installed searchAppRecords re-proof; P5 with-db integration suite execution + two-session live chat; P6 live install/upload/preview proofs; P8 live socket/badge + live email delivery; P9 live dispatch proofs (assistant, chat PRIVATE denial, drive, projects, recipe materialization, suggestions browser); P10 performance profiling + final regression (full e2e, clean-2.39 upgrade chain, uninstall-everything); P0 leftover full 621-spec sweep (chunked) + prod-composition checks. Deferred — blocked upstream: ALL P7 bullets (P7.0 gate BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED live: replay/numbering/rounding/period-close/alternate-API proofs, live iban-denial proof, reviewer sign-off, D03/D04); P1.6d Bilan sheet/fiche legs (P7 + seeding); P1.6e, P1.7a, P1.7b remaining legs (literal dep P1.6c open); P3.4 all three bullets (gated on durable-save acceptance / feasibility check / explicitly deferred); P4.2 retroplanning (after P4.1, not [x]) and dependency-picker completion (maintainer decision: blockIssue is task→note); P4.3 calendar links (P4C.5 owns); P4C.2 (P4C.1 §10 product confirmation pending) and chained P4C.3/4/5; P9.2 Accounting AI + Projects AI suggestion layer (P9.1/P7-gated); P9.3 workflow-recipe and suggestions remaining legs (P7 + Tier 2).

userStories.title: [P1.6c] Unified setup UI — preview apps/prerequisites/samples/customization, blank/CRM, optional app exclusion (both entrypoints)
userStories.description: As a workspace owner, I want onboarding and Settings to preview exactly what a template will apply before anything is installed, so that I can choose blank/CRM or exclude optional apps with full knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P1.6c verbatim: 'preview apps, prerequisites, samples and customization; allow blank/CRM, optional app exclusion' — the preview shows resolved apps (install/keep/unavailable), prerequisites, optional samples and customization before any apply

Both entrypoints (onboarding template step and Settings → workspace template) call the same P1.6b setup operation — C2 verbatim: 'Unify preset and manual app selection into one resolved request; no double install path.'
C1 verbatim: 'Unavailable optional apps can be excluded; required dependency errors block only the affected bundle.'
Built on existing Twenty front primitives (existing InstallApps onboarding page patterns, Settings sections, navigation) — no parallel setup UI, no new shell
Front unit suites cover preview resolution states (install/keep/unavailable), exclusion toggles and entrypoint parity; no browser run
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:583 (P1.6c `[ ]`, not-started). Deps met: P1.6b verified 2026-09-19 (US-016/017/018). Unlocks P1.6e/P1.7a/P1.7b remaining legs. Tier-2 browser journey deferred to orchestrator.

userStories.title: [P1.6c] Partial-failure UX — continue with successful steps, retry later, empty-catalogue protection
userStories.description: As a workspace owner whose setup partially failed, I want to see exactly what failed and continue or retry later, so that successful work is kept and my template choice is never silently discarded.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P1.6c verbatim: 'continue with successful steps and retry later. Empty catalogue cannot discard template choice.'
C2 verbatim: 'Partial failure keeps successful work, shows exactly what failed, allows retry/skip optional steps, and never reports the entire preset applied.'
C2 verbatim: 'No apps available, network error and permission denial must have distinct UI, without losing template choice.'
Retry revalidates permissions and versions on resume (C2) and reuses the same operation; per-step status (pending/running/succeeded/failed/skipped) rendered truthfully from the P1.6b operation result
Front unit suites cover the failure/retry/skip states and the empty-catalogue protection; no browser run
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:583 (P1.6c `[ ]`). Builds on US-026's preview surface; C2 contract is the binding spec (docs/plan/05-template-contracts.md).

userStories.title: [P1.3] Fix post-install delegated seeding completing with 0 rows — truthful step status
userStories.description: As a workspace owner applying a preset, I want post-install sample/starter seeding to actually write its rows and report failure truthfully, so that 'succeeded (delegated)' never over-reports a broken install.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P1.3 verbatim scope: 'Complete preset orchestration through existing server service (not a new logic-function): partial-state reporting, owned navigation and optional samples' — the remaining leg is the recorded live seeding failure

Ledger verbatim: 'live scratch shows app post-install hooks completing while seeding 0 rows (phase-01-report 2026-09-16 orchestrator entry) — "succeeded (delegated)" can over-report until the hook failure is fixed'
Root-cause the 0-rows failure and fix it inside the existing workspace-template service / app post-install hooks — no new logic-function, no new table, no parallel seeding system
A delegated seeding step that wrote 0 rows cannot report succeeded — it reports failed/skipped with a safe, localized reason (C2 truthful per-step status)

Regression unit tests reproduce the 0-rows path and assert row-count-truthful statuses; the existing 15/15 partial-state spec batch stays green; fix is additive (no preset behavior change for already-working paths)
The P1.6d Bilan starter hook shares this code path and is covered by the fix, but Bilan bundle content itself stays out of scope (P7 gate)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:540-547 (P1.3 `[~]`, partial: partial states + delegated sample-seeding shipped, spec 15/15). Stability-critical: blocks truthful P1.6d seeding. Live scratch re-proof stays Tier 2 (orchestrator).

userStories.title: [P1.6d] Persona starter bundles — student/journal/team/non-profit/small-business, ready apps only
userStories.description: As a new workspace owner, I want persona starter bundles whose previewed contents only include ready apps, so that I never activate blocked or unavailable modules.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P1.6d verbatim: 'Add proposed student/journal/team/non-profit/small-business bundles with previewed contents and only compatible ready apps; keep CRM-only available.'
Bundles defined as data in the existing workspace-template/preset definitions; preview payloads unit-tested like the shipped Bilan sheet fixtures
Only ready apps included (Documents/Projects); Bilan content excluded and recorded as blocked upstream (P7.0 gate) — unavailable optional apps are excluded per C1/C2, never silently dropped
C1 verbatim: 'Samples default off and are distinguishable from operational defaults (e.g. ledger/categories).'
Repeat-safe by construction: bundle payloads carry no record IDs, tokens, share URLs or live finance rows (C1 construction rule)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:587 (P1.6d `[~]`, partial: Bilan payloads shipped, persona bundles unshipped). Bilan legs deferred — blocked upstream (P7). dependsOn US-028 so seeding inherits the truthful hook path.

userStories.title: [P3.2] Template instantiation — fetch authorized body, remap IDs/anchors, prove copy independence
userStories.description: As a user creating a document from a template, I want instantiation to fetch the authorized template body and remap identifiers, so that my copy is independent, complete and safe.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P3.2 verbatim: 'Complete template instantiation + gallery composition: helper and LIST view exist, but browser does not select template content. Fetch authorized body, remap IDs/anchors and prove copy independence (C1, E04).'
C1 verbatim: 'Instantiate fresh content IDs with source-template/version provenance; validate/remap relations and block/comment identifiers. Editing a copy does not mutate its template.'
Template body fetched under the caller's authorization — fail-closed on missing/unauthorized template (reuse the verified authorized-content access pattern, US-013 enabler)
C1 verbatim: 'Template deletion never deletes existing instances.' — unit-proven
Copy independence proven by unit tests: fresh IDs, remapped anchors/relations, provenance recorded (source template key + version), editing the copy never mutates the template
No browser run; the E04 gallery-instantiation journey leg stays deferred to the orchestrator
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:739 (P3.2 `[ ]`, not-started; helper + LIST view exist). Deps met: P1.6a [x], P3 core verified (US-019/020/021/022).

userStories.title: [P3.2] Durable revision history — replace in-memory EditorVersionHistoryStore
userStories.description: As a document author, I want revision history persisted server-side, so that retention, block diff and restore-as-new-revision survive reload and respect permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P3.2 verbatim: 'Persist revision history; current `EditorVersionHistoryStore` is an in-memory ring buffer. Retention, block diff and restore-as-new-revision must survive reload and respect permissions (E05).'
Persistence reuses app-owned metadata patterns (additive revision object in a2e-documents with generated migration if a table is needed) — no parallel version engine, no hand-created workspace tables
Restore creates a new revision (never a destructive in-place rewrite); read/write permission checks fail closed; retention policy explicit and documented in the app docs
Unit tests: store round-trips through the server transport (not memory), block diff computed between revisions, restore-as-new-revision, unauthorized access denied
Reload-survival browser proof stays deferred to the orchestrator (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:742 (P3.2 `[ ]`, not-started). Mirrors the shipped documentCommentThread persistence pattern.

userStories.title: [P3.2] Atomic expected-revision save with conflict feedback and preserved draft (no OT/CRDT)
userStories.description: As a document author, I want saves to carry an expected revision, so that stale saves conflict loudly instead of silently overwriting and my draft is preserved on conflict.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P3.2 verbatim: 'Atomic expected-revision save with conflict feedback and preserved draft; presence and pure optimistic classification helper exist, but do not implement a server save/merge protocol. No OT/CRDT promise in v1.'
E05 anchor: 'Stale saves cannot silently overwrite' — concurrent writers produce a deterministic winner, never interleaved corruption

Server-side compare-and-set implemented via the app's existing logic-function pattern (SDK exposes no pre-write hook — post-commit repair only, per the phase-03-recorded platform caveat); no merge protocol, no OT/CRDT, no new event bus
Conflict feedback and preserved draft wired through the existing editor stores; front unit tests cover conflict, retry and draft preservation
Single-writer guidance documented alongside (cross-cutting risk table: 'Version check + conflict banner; single-writer guidance in docs')
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:763 (P3.2 `[ ]`, not-started). Presence + optimistic classification helpers already exist and must be reused. Gates the P3.4 template/import bullet (still deferred this batch).

userStories.title: [P3.3] Record integration — actual selected-note body copy with source link and permission checks
userStories.description: As a CRM user, I want the record-to-document command to copy the selected note's actual authorized body with a source link, so that the document contains the real content instead of a title snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P3.3 verbatim: 'Record integration: preserve existing company/person relation fields; implement actual selected-note body copy with source link and permission checks. Existing record command/title snapshot is not note-body copying. Test both record types and open from search/relation/side-panel.'
C5 verbatim: 'Copying a note into a document copies actual authorized content and records provenance; linking must not silently duplicate content.'
Body copy goes through the existing template-copy helper with permission checks failing closed on unauthorized notes; provenance/source link recorded on the copy
Both record types (company and person) covered by unit tests; existing company/person relation fields preserved (additive only)
Entry points reachable from search/relation/side-panel per existing command wiring — no browser run
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:787 (P3.3 `[ ]`, not-started). Reuses the document template-copy helper; do not invent a second copy mechanism.

userStories.title: [P4.2] Board view — kanban on task grouped by custom status (prefer existing primitives)
userStories.description: As a project member, I want a kanban board of tasks grouped by custom status, so that I can move work across the pipeline using Twenty's existing board experience.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P4.2 verbatim: 'Board view (kanban by custom status — extend view types if needed; prefer existing kanban view on task with status grouping)'

P4 acceptance verbatim: 'Existing board/My tasks/calendar definitions must be validated, not recreated.' — audit the existing a2e-projects board definition and complete missing UX, do not build a second board system
Status semantics reconciled before adding any status logic (C5: 'Reconcile existing `status` versus `projectStatus` before adding more status logic.')
Moving a task between groups updates the same status every surface reads (C5: 'board, My tasks, project page, due-date calendar and record tasks tab show the same IDs/status/assignee')
Manifest build passes; view/field definitions unit-verified; app-local typecheck + test:unit green; live install proof deferred (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:855 (P4.2 `[ ]`, not-started; board definition exists in source per P4 ledger row).

userStories.title: [P4.2] Calendar view of task due dates — link into the existing calendar surface
userStories.description: As a project member, I want task due dates visible on a calendar view, so that I can see deadlines without confusing them with scheduled provider events.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P4.2 verbatim: 'Calendar view of tasks/due dates (link into existing calendar module surface)'
C5 verbatim: 'Calendar distinguishes task due dates from scheduled events/time blocks. Displaying a deadline must not automatically send provider invitations.'
Reuses the existing calendar view definition/primitives in a2e-projects (validated, not recreated); no two-way task/event link — P4C.5 owns opt-in synchronization
Manifest build passes; view definition unit-verified; app-local typecheck + test:unit green; live proof deferred (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:862 (P4.2 `[ ]`, not-started; calendar definition exists in source per P4 ledger row).

userStories.title: [P4.2] My-tasks page — assigned to me, created by me, overdue smart lists
userStories.description: As a workspace member, I want a My-tasks page with assigned-to-me, created-by-me and overdue smart lists, so that my own work is reachable in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P4.2 verbatim: 'My-tasks page ('assigned to me' + 'created by me' + overdue smart lists)'
Reuses the existing My-tasks view definitions in a2e-projects (validated, not recreated); filter definitions unit-verified
C5: same task IDs/status/assignee as board and record surfaces — the smart lists are filters over the standard task, not a parallel task store
Manifest build passes; app-local typecheck + test:unit green; live proof deferred (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:871 (P4.2 `[ ]`, not-started; my-tasks view definition exists in source per P4 ledger row).

userStories.title: [P4.3] Project ↔ document relation — linked docs on project overview
userStories.description: As a project member, I want to link documents to a project and see them on the project overview, so that project knowledge lives one click away.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P4.3 verbatim: 'Documents: doc relation on project; project overview shows linked docs'
Additive relation field only (direction following the existing cross-app precedent, e.g. invoice→project); no renames/removals, no duplicate document objects
C5 verbatim: 'Stable record links open in the native side panel or full page and show a safe missing/removed state, never another tenant.'
C4: optional cross-app link degrades safely when Documents is not installed
Manifest build passes; relation + overview section unit-verified; app-local typecheck + test:unit green; live install proof deferred (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:904 (P4.3 `[ ]`, not-started). Deps met: P3 core verified. Gates the docs tab of US-038.

userStories.title: [P4.2] Project page — overview widgets (health, milestones, members, activity) + tabs (tasks/board/gantt/files/docs)
userStories.description: As a project member, I want a complete project page with overview widgets and tabs, so that all project surfaces are reachable from one native page.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P4.2 verbatim: 'Project page: overview widgets (health, milestones, members, activity) + tabs (tasks/board/gantt/files/docs)'
Existing overview component completed, not recreated (P4 ledger: overview exists in source); tabs reuse existing page-layout/tab primitives
Docs tab consumes the US-037 project↔document relation; gantt tab embeds the existing timeline widget (its DOM render/1k-task benchmark proof stays Tier 2 with the orchestrator)
Widgets and tabs unit-verified; manifest build passes; app-local typecheck + test:unit green
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:873 (P4.2 `[ ]`, partial-by-ledger: overview component exists). dependsOn US-037 for the docs tab.

userStories.title: [P4] CSV/bulk task import/export — validation and partial-row error feedback on native import
userStories.description: As a project member, I want to import and export tasks in bulk with validation and per-row error feedback, so that bulk edits are safe and failures are understandable.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P4 acceptance verbatim: 'Add CSV/bulk task import/export with validation and partial-row error feedback (R03), reusing native import.'
Native import/export pipelines reused — no new import engine; escaping and field/permission mapping validated
Partial failures report per-row errors without silent partial commits; successful rows keep their result
Unit tests cover validation, escaping and error feedback paths
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:923-924 (P4 acceptance paragraph — a plan need without its own checkbox). Explicitly reuses native import per the bullet.

userStories.title: [P9.1] Assistant surface — full-page upgrade of ai-chat + input-schema-aware context mapping (+ channel-side context)
userStories.description: As a workspace member, I want the assistant available as a full page with context from my current view, so that I can work with AI beyond the side panel without leaving context behind.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P9.1 verbatim: 'Assistant surface: side-panel assistant + full-page upgrade of ai-chat; context injection from current view (record/doc/channel/invoice) via context-store'

Ledger verbatim remaining legs: 'Full-page upgrade, input-schema-aware context mapping, channel-side context and direct tool execution remain' — full-page upgrade, input-schema-aware context mapping and channel-side context are in scope; direct tool execution stays out (dispatch proofs are Tier 2)
Reuses existing ai-chat components and the context-store — no new assistant shell; US-025 behavior preserved: fail-closed gating, read-only dispatch, mutating categories never offered
Front suites (ai/utils + ai/components) extended and green on the touched specs; live dispatch proof deferred (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:1369 (P9.1 `[~]`, partial: side-panel half verified US-025 2026-09-19). Deps met: P1.5 native registry verified.

userStories.title: [P9.1] Streaming responses (SSE reuse) + usage logging to event-logs + provider config from existing AI settings
userStories.description: As a workspace member using the assistant, I want streamed responses and auditable usage logs, so that answers arrive progressively and every AI call is traceable.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P9.1 verbatim: 'Streaming responses (SSE reuse), model provider config (existing AI settings), usage logging to event-logs'
Reuses the existing SSE infrastructure — no new transport; model provider configuration read from the existing AI settings surface
Usage entries written to event-logs per assistant/tool call (consumed later by US-043's audit page)
Server unit tests cover streaming plumbing and usage-log writes; live streaming proof deferred (Tier 2)
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:1378 (P9.1 `[ ]`, not-started). Gates US-043 (audit page needs usage data).

userStories.title: [P9.2] Documents AI actions — summarize, translate, improve writing (read-only tools)
userStories.description: As a document author, I want summarize, translate and improve-writing actions on my documents, so that I get AI help without giving the assistant write access.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P9.2 verbatim: 'Documents: summarize, extract tasks→P4, translate, improve writing' — extract-tasks is verified (US-009); this story builds the remaining three actions on the verified authorized `document-content` access tool (US-013)
All three tools are read-only, caller-permission-scoped, and fail closed to a safe error on missing/unauthorized documents (same pattern as US-009/US-013)
Registered via manifest `toolTriggerSettings` on app logic functions — no new AI registry, table or registration hook (P1.5)
C6: creates nothing, posts nothing; app-local typecheck + test:unit green on a2e-documents
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:1384 (P9.2 `[~]`, partial: enablers verified 2026-09-19). Live assistant-catalogue invocation stays Tier 2.

userStories.title: [P9.2b] Permission/workspace-scoped private-result cache — versions, expiry, invalidation
userStories.description: As a platform maintainer, I want AI results cached per workspace and permission scope with version keys and invalidation, so that private data never leaks across workspaces and stale results expire.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P9.2b verbatim: 'Permission/workspace-scoped private-result cache; only public-only catalogue results may be shared globally after review (C6). Include model/data/catalogue versions, expiry and deletion/role-change invalidation.'
Reuses/extends the existing aiCacheEntry patterns — workspace/access-scoped keys with model/data/catalogue versions; C6 verbatim: 'No cross-workspace cache leak.'
Invalidation on permission/data changes and role changes; expiry honored; no global sharing of anything but reviewed public-catalogue results
Unit tests: scope isolation, version/permission invalidation, expiry behavior
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:1415 (P9.2b `[ ]`, not-started). The P7.1f aiCacheEntry C6 validation bullet stays deferred (P7-gated); this story is the generic cache contract only.

userStories.title: [P9.2b] Saved runs — authorized persisted results, zero-provider-call re-open, explicit rerun with cost estimate
userStories.description: As a workspace member, I want saved AI runs I can reopen without new provider calls, with any rerun as an explicit action showing a cost estimate, so that reopening history never costs money or leaks data.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN.md P9.2b verbatim: 'Saved runs persist authorized results; reopening them makes zero provider calls. Test workspace switching, changed permissions and expired results; an explicit rerun is a separate user action with a visible cost estimate.'
Persistence keyed to the US-043 cache contract (workspace/access-scoped, versioned); re-open serves authorized stored results only
Unit tests cover workspace switching, changed permissions and expired results; rerun is a distinct action with a visible cost estimate
C6: saved-run re-open must incur no new provider call — asserted by test
userStories.notes: PLAN.md:1418 (P9.2b `[ ]`, not-started). dependsOn US-043 (cache layer is the storage contract).

userStories.notes: PLAN.md:1439 (P9.3 `[ ]`, not-started). dependsOn US-041 (usage data source).
